reportedIssues: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in 'Fastest near you' displays '€NaN delivery' — an unformatted/undefined numeric value leaking into the UI instead of a price.

The favorite (heart) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has no visible circular background, while the same button on the pizza card below sits on a dark translucent circle. On the light/busy ramen artwork the outlined heart is harder to see and the treatment is inconsistent.
Time ranges use a mathematical minus sign ('15−25 min', '20−30 min', '25−35 min') rather than an en dash, which reads oddly and can be mispronounced by screen readers.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes the delivery fee displaying €NaN.
